_readme: Round 3: user direction = simpler, less detail, items like a casual stylized-3D game item model (Fortnite-like) rather than detailed 3D. Detail is where AI errors come from. The look is DESCRIBED, never named. Subjects are deliberately simple (few large parts, no embroidery/pouches/patterns). Armor pieces use the real per-slot rules via 'slot'.
name: round3
title: Round 3: simplified stylized-3D item look (rows) x items (columns), 2 seeds
framing: single subject centered, entire subject visible, plain flat light grey background
palette: bright saturated colors, warm early-game palette
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, cropped, cut off, busy background, scenery, landscape, ground, environment, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, deformed, intricate details, fine patterns, embroidery, ornate, filigree, stitching, small text, clutter, realistic texture, photorealistic, photo, gritty, grunge, noise, scratches
